period_note: Sourced directly from the bank's own primary quarterly interim financial statements ("Financial Statements for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2018 (Unaudited)"), downloaded directly from the bank's live financial-statements archive (legacy.citybankplc.com/report/financialstatements), not Wayback Machine. Per project convention the SOLO ('Balance Sheet as at 30 September 2018' / unlabelled 'Profit and Loss Account for the 3rd Quarter ended 30 September 2018') figures are used, not the explicitly-labelled 'Consolidated' panels (Consolidated total operating income of 11,613.42m [sic -- Consolidated is actually 12,156.41m; Solo is 11,613.42m] and Consolidated NPAT of 2,249.61m are materially different from Solo and were not used). Arithmetically verified: Total liabilities 303,153,340,501 + Shareholders' equity 24,158,874,911 = Total assets 327,312,215,412 exactly; Net interest income 6,630,115,526 + Investment income 1,323,261,527 + Commission 2,239,408,153 + Other operating income 1,420,637,430 = Total operating income 11,613,422,636 exactly. Year-to-date NPAT (2,081,709,071) minus the 2018_Q2.json H1 figure (1,220.77m) implies a Q3-alone NPAT of ~860.9m, which matches this filing's own 'Current Quarter' column net profit after taxation (860,935,210) closely -- cross-validated against the already-completed 2018_Q2 quarter. Solo and Consolidated off-balance-sheet totals are identical (139,767,594,678) since the bank issues its contingent liabilities/commitments directly rather than through subsidiaries. Non Funded Income is calculated as Commission/exchange/brokerage + Other operating income (both individually reported). NAV per share is not disclosed in the primary interim statement and is left out as a genuine gap. 2018 Q1 could not be recovered (see 2018_Q2.json note: the bank's own archive lists only a corrupted placeholder file for that quarter and no other capture exists on Wayback Machine); independently re-confirmed this session by downloading the placeholder file directly -- it is a generic 4-paragraph 'Adobe Acrobat PDF Files' sample document with no financial content, not a truncation or access issue.
